title: The Gilded Ember
author: Gideon Sandoval
blurb: Odile Brightwater, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
